description: TikTok Intelligence ET: list Video API.

createdByAi.description: Whether AI video, only accepts the string `"true"` (AI video) or `"false"` (non-AI video), non-Boolean

isAd.description: Whether to stream video: 0 = no streaming video, 1 = streaming video

maxCreateTime.description: Release time range filtering (second-level timestamp) - maximum value

maxDuration.description: Video duration range filtering (seconds) - maximum value

minCreateTime.description: Release time range filtering (second-level timestamp)-minimum value

minDuration.description: Video duration range filtering (seconds) - minimum value

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. **Must be a multiple of 10, the maximum is 100**; the upper limit for a single page of the third-party interface is 10, internally press 10 for each page to be pulled multiple times and then merged

productCategoryId.description: Associated product category ID. Maximum length 1000

productId.description: Product ID associated with the video. Maximum length 1000

region.description: Area code. Optional values: US (United States), ID (Indonesia), TH (Thailand), PH (Philippines), MY (Malaysia), VN (Vietnam), GB (UK), MX (Mexico), SG (Singapore), SA (Saudi Arabia), BR (Brazil), ES (Spain), JP (Japan), DE (Germany), IT (Italy), FR (France)

salesFlag.description: Whether to bring goods video: 0 = no goods carrying video, 1 = goods carrying video

videoSortField.description: Sorting fields: 1=total_digg_cnt (number of likes), 2=create_time (release time), 3=total_views_cnt (number of views)
